negative_to_zero.reason: CPU P8 two-generation random-list preflight reached 99,987,640 KiB RSS (about 95.36 GiB) and was stopped; GPU known-solution audit failed. No trustworthy P1024 timing or qualified speedup.
negative_to_zero.reproduction: Generic GPU reproduction is available; this does not establish GPU evaluation correctness or bounded CPU resource use.

stock_with_cooldown.reason: Existing memoized coordinate transitions cannot express ASGP clamped dependencies exactly.

pilot_policy: pilot/ preserves the interrupted original attempt; pilot-supported/ is the two-task pilot.
seed_policy: Three independent searches; ranges describe seed variability, not repeated identical workloads.
ratios: Median of seed-matched ASGP ratios; measured ratios are descriptive only when scoped correctness checks fail.
process_time: Tagged real runs require GNU /usr/bin/time resources process_wall_s (10 ms resolution). Monitor elapsed, including up to 500 ms polling tail, is retained separately. Untagged synthetic/legacy records explicitly fall back to a monitor estimate.
qualification_scope: Qualified means passes known-solution checks and final top-16 CPU audit for GPU modes; not exact full-population or per-case parity. See cpu_audit_program_count for actual sample size. Initial full-population differences are reported separately.
initial_snapshot_policy: Initial aggregate-fitness differences are reported, not used to discard timings; successful limited checks do not establish exact parity.

initial_snapshot_summary.scope: Full frozen initial population aggregate fitness; not per-case output parity or evolving-population parity
initial_snapshot_summary.metric_provenance: Common fitness confirmed by snapshot manifest; output SHA256 verified

quality: Same independent local ASGP test split, 1024 cases per checkpoint; not official PSB. Natural duplicates and possible training overlap retained.
list_fitness: Common exact metric: ASGP negative error + 1024; GAGP correct count. Native-policy controls must not use this conversion.
